notes.title: DevLog 3# New Mechanics & Prologue Release Date!
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/xdqYs4sFyq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello Chefs! 👨‍🍳[/h1]

As independent developers, we’ve been working hard to bring you the best experience possible.

In our last update, we made the tough decision to postpone the release of the Prologue version. We wanted to make sure everything was just right – and now, the wait is finally over!

[h1][b]New Features Are Here! 🎉[/b][/h1]

We’ve been working non-stop to add brand new mechanics and polish existing ones. Your feedback has been a huge part of this journey – thank you for helping shape the game! Let’s dive into what’s new:

[h2][b]Placement! 🧱[/b][/h2]

You can now place and move objects wherever you want in your restaurant! Organize your kitchen layout to match your style and efficiency. Freedom is yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/3d1fb0a1f18b06c3812f4f9f68fea855bb57ff66.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Pizza Station! 🍕[/b][/h2]

Yes, pizza is now officially on the menu! Prepare dough, add toppings, bake it right, and keep those slices coming. Get creative with your orders and keep customers happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/66f7de646b8d1c84a0c49272ce035745eb314748.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Kebab (Doner) Station 🌯[/b][/h2]

Spice things up with the all new doner station! Slice from the rotating grill, serve it in bread or wraps, and become a kebab master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/fa745d78256fc919f3e72d96783046309e96c827.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Grill Zones! 🔥[/b][/h2]

Not every spot on the grill is the same anymore. Some areas are hotter and cook faster, while others are cooler. Pay attention to where you place your food – timing matters more than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/625099725a16da26d3c93fec15b3484df1cd07cd.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Repair Mechanic! 🛠️[/b][/h2]

Machines wear out with use. If you ignore them too long, they can break or worse, catch fire! Keep your equipment in top shape with regular maintenance and avoid disasters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/b7788a96961b4d00236c3dad779e30072bc3e74e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Level System 📈[/b][/h2]

We’ve added a level system! Gain XP by running your restaurant, and unlock better machines, tools, and features as you level up. Progression has never been this fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/1c58bdc05ed0da043900615e2184a712baa9f02d.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Fry Station! 🍟[/b][/h2]

French fries are now here to make your customers even happier! Use the new multiple fryer system to serve them fast and crispy. No one likes soggy fries, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/9641f7c50122fe231fbfef4cbaaec09c488dd4f8.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Our Upcoming Games![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062150/Car_Service_Simulator/

[h1][b]Add to Wishlist! ✔️[/b][/h1]

Excited to jump in? Then don’t forget to add Drive Thru Simulator: Prologue to your wishlist! It helps us a lot and ensures you don’t miss any updates or release news.

notes.title: Drive Thru Simulator Prologue Release Delayed!
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/xdqYs4sFyq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello, Chefs! 👨‍🍳[/b][/h1]

I know many of you have been eagerly counting down the days for the release of Drive Thru Simulator Prologue, originally scheduled for February 13, 2025. Seeing your excitement means the world to us, and it’s something that truly drives us forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/76441d4d0b5117c1a0ccf72b77de792762a0a8aa.jpg[/img]

That said, we want to ensure that every release we bring to you meets your expectations while being as polished and error-free as possible. After careful consideration, we’ve decided to push the release date a little bit further to give the game the extra refinement it deserves.

We now plan to launch the Prologue after Steam Next Fest, and we’ll be announcing the new release date very soon.

Thank you for your patience and understanding! Your support keeps us going, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

notes.title: New Update - Drive Thru Simulator (v.0.9)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/p79G9yFAyx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello, Drive Thru Players! 🍟🍔 [/b][/h1]

Following the Steam Next Fest and the Land Of Crescent Turkey event, we’ve once again felt the energy and passion of the gaming community. Now it’s time to introduce you to our culinary adventure, the Cooking Fest event, where the art of cooking takes center stage!

Thanks to your interest in these events and the valuable feedback you’ve shared, we’re making step-by-step improvements to the game. With our latest update, we’re working to make your gameplay experience richer and smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/4b95434f8679c68e9c957d642795c6fbe8bff345.png[/img]

[h1][b]New Features 📌[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Trash System[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ A new system has been added that rewards players with money when trash is taken outside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/eb22737e4ee0f1c55c0cf04155b12562fc34217e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Order Control System[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ A system for detailed control and management of order contents has been added.

[h2][b]Customer Satisfaction[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ The impact of customer satisfaction on gameplay and player success has been made more evident.

[h2][b]Office Decoration[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ A system for buying and placing objects in the office area of the market has been added.

[b]✅ Objects can be rotated with the Q and E keys and placed with the R key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/d12feac5de6f430f43eaa4785485cabbd23a6b8f.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Grill Management and Interactions[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ The grill can be moved and positioned.

[b]✅ The cooking status of patties is displayed on the user interface.

[b]✅ Sound and visual effects have been added to the grilling process.

[h2][b]Burger Stand UI and Ingredient Visuals[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ Objects placed on the burger stand are now displayed in the user interface.

[b]✅ Ingredients are supported with visual effects.

[h2][b]Area Pollution[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ The pollution level of used areas is now traceable.

[b]✅ The quality of food prepared in dirty areas and its impact on customer satisfaction has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/788f296caf5c025d317f2128346e730a8c222009.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Customer Reactions[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ Customers can notice dirt and react accordingly:

Phase 1: In slightly dirty areas, the chance of customers noticing is low.
Phase 2: In moderately dirty areas, the chance is higher. 
Phase 3: In very dirty areas, cleaning becomes mandatory as customers will definitely notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/a4601ebe19e32081ae3b9ec9a75f120eae99acdc.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Cleaning Supplies[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ Various cleaning products have been added to the market and are now usable.

[b]✅ The durability of cleaning products is now tracked in the game.

[h2][b]Object Data[/b][/h2]

[b]✅ Detailed data for each object is now accessible to the user.

[h2][b]Cargo System[/b][/h2]

Changes and improvements have been made to the cargo system.

[b]✅ A handcart has been added to the market and can be used for cargo transportation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/d709bb4ad9b6b643b96341a65b2b2d04e1e00eea.gif[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h2][b]Tutorial System[/b][/h2]

✅ Improvements and bug fixes have been made to the tutorial system to make it easier for players to adapt.

Let’s head to the kitchens! See you at the Cooking Fest!

notes.title: Drive Thru Simulator - Bug Fixes (v.0.7)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/p79G9yFAyx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Drive Thru Simulator Players! 🍟🍔 [/b][/h1]

[b]Thanks so much for all your feedback it really helps us make the game better for you! We know that bugs can be a real pain, and we're on it, working hard to squash them as fast as we can. In this latest update, we’re excited to share some of the tweaks and new additions that have been made to enhance your gaming experience:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/4b95434f8679c68e9c957d642795c6fbe8bff345.png[/img]

[h2][b]Update Details 📌[/b][/h2]

[b]✅Optimization Improved: Significant enhancements made to customer spawn, garbage collection, and other processes.[/b]

[b]✅Tutorial Improvements.[/b]

[b]✅Character Customization Issue Resolved.[/b]

[b]✅Burger Patty Cooking Issue Fixed.[/b]

[b]✅ Shopping and Cargo System Issues Fixed: Problems with cargo and shopping have been corrected.[/b]

[b]✅ Runtime Localization Improved.[/b]

[b]✅ Cursorhair Hiding.[/b]

[b]✅Cart Money Control: Money in the cart can no longer go negative.[/b]

[b]✅ "Order Completed" Localization: Order completion information is now available in your local language.[/b]


Thank you for your patience and support! If you encounter any other issues, please let us know. We are always working to improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: New Update - Burger Patty & Sign Board (v.0.3)

 [url=https://discord.gg/p79G9yFAyx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png[/img][/url]


[h1][b]Hello Drive Thru Players! 👨‍🍳🍔[/b][/h1]

We've got some fresh off the grill updates for you! This latest patch brings with it new features, crunchy improvements and some well-done warnings (no burnt food on our watch!). Check out what's cooking below. 


[h2][b]🍔 Burger Patty System: Now with Extra Flavor![/b][/h2]

Burger Patty Cooking Area - Finally, a place for those precious patties! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/bf16d6daccdca4055d380e95e42abc3ffdea433d.gif[/img]

Top and Bottom Percentage of Doneness Indicator - Because no one likes a half-cooked burger. Cook like a pro, 100% every time! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/2d1c22f8162bb5fc28ee8fd11a422d12f4210fc2.gif[/img]

Placing Cooked Patties into Burger Containers - Say goodbye to messy counters and hello to efficiency! 🍔


[h2][b]📢 Sign Customization: Make Your Mark![/b][/h2]

Shop Sign Customization - Customize your sign, give your shop the sparkle it deserves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/4e1f15e5c62838bd237fc4d7f3791d2607836bb4.gif[/img]

New Road Sign - Now your customers can't miss you even if they try! 🚦


[h2][b]There's more![/b][/h2]

Burn Warnings for Pizza and Potatoes - No more serving charcoal-flavored snacks. We are behind you 🚨

Office Design Added to Market System - Time to make your office less... sad. Decorate and thrive! 


[h1]Thanks for playing and supporting us! [/h1]

Careful don't burn the kitchen! 🔥
